sections.title: Accessories
notes: New accessory type for solid or partly solid objects: bags, belts, straps, holsters, helmets.
Import as accessory button at the top of Adjust fit and pose.
Paint deform mask: painted parts bend with the body, the rest stays exactly rigid.
Lattice deform to reshape an accessory with a box of control points.
Sculpt accessory, with the same brushes as garments.
Parent to joint for props that must never deform, using the searchable joint list with the hierarchy toggle.
Extended influence: how far garments on top keep their lift past the accessory's edge.
Runs on a low-poly cage, so painting, moving and lattice editing stay fast on heavy meshes.

sections.title: Cages
notes: Cage from Avatar: builds the cage from the patch of skin the object covers. Belts and strap sets get one smooth, easy-to-deform shape instead of a cage that follows every strap and hole.
Accessory cages can go down to 0.2 cm.
Cage settings for accessories live only in Adjust fit and pose.

sections.title: Adjust fit and pose
notes: Place garments and accessories with a move, rotate and scale gizmo, with rotation snap (Off, 45°, 90°) and a Reset position icon.
Snap two points: click a point on the object and a point on the avatar or a garment, turn the target plane freely with its own gizmo, then snap them face to face.
Feet tilt and Feet turn in Pose to match, for shoes.
Focus mode: only the fitting tools are shown while fitting.
See-through colour picker.

sections.title: Layers
notes: Layers show their number (name on hover), with a forces icon for Receive, Cast and Receive from Garments.
Layer forces: a garment or accessory can take the push of the layers above it, with a Self / Layers above balance, how many levels to count, and an influence slider per layer.
Layer transition group in Garment options: distance slider and the Layer transition brush.
Compact Move row with up and down arrows at the top of the stack.

sections.title: Painting
notes: Deform mask and Layer transition painting share one layout: Black · white or Heat map view, Isolate object toggle, brush size and strength.
Shift + drag smooths, Shift + right drag clamps to fully on or off.
Fill, Clear and Smooth for the whole mask, then Cancel and Done.
Return to fitting shows below the panel while painting a mask during import.

sections.title: Fixes
notes: Layer transition feathering is more precise on large garments.
Heat map colours are no longer washed out.
Garments over an accessory band no longer sink inside it when receiving from the layers above.
New menu bar: File, Edit, Settings and Info.
Save and open projects as .ft3d files.
Undo and redo for wearing, taking off, layer order, visibility and sculpt strokes.
Edit > Select last jumps back to the garment you selected before.
Smooth and Construct relax the cage toward the spacing it had when generated, so cells stay square like a quad mesh.
Layer transition: where a garment hangs past the edge of the one underneath, the lift fades out gradually instead of snapping to the skin.
Settings: autosave with an interval, antialiasing, frame cap.
Custom keyboard shortcuts, with import and export as JSON.
Loading intro.
About closes when you click outside it.
First beta: garment import, Adjust fit and pose, proxy cage, sculpting, layers, measurements, Map binding, avatar textures, .glb export.
